name: Pip
description: I just learned how all the pieces move. Mostly. Shall we find out together?

name: Dottie
description: Every piece I own is precious. I might never trade a single one.

name: Bramble
description: Charge! I move whatever is closest to your king.

name: Marlo
description: I can do the knight's L-shape with my eyes closed. The rest I'm still working on.

name: Tansy
description: I like my pawns in a tidy row. Please don't knock them over.

name: Quill
description: I write down every move. Reading them back afterwards is the hard part.

name: Juniper
description: Checks first, questions later. That's my whole plan.

name: Bastian
description: I count the pieces before every capture. Usually.

name: Wren
description: I castle early, then wonder what comes next. Show me?

name: Castor
description: My queen comes out on move two. Every single game.

name: Lumi
description: Slow and steady. I'd rather keep a pawn than chase a king.

name: Barnaby
description: Retired lighthouse keeper. I spot trouble coming from a long way off.

name: Oona
description: I've just started seeing forks everywhere. Have you?

name: Fennick
description: Gambits are free pawns for the brave. Care to take one?

name: Saffi
description: I play the same setup every game, and I know every corner of it.

name: Teodor
description: Ask me about pins. Better yet, try to stay out of mine.

name: Maribel
description: Weekend tournament regular. I bring snacks and a spare scoresheet.

name: Corwin
description: Give me a closed position and a long afternoon.

name: Imke
description: I review every loss. Let's give me something to review.

name: Rafferty
description: If there's a sacrifice on the board, I've already counted it twice.

name: Selka
description: Endgames are my favourite part. See if you can get us there in one piece.

name: Hollis
description: I don't blunder much, and I don't apologise for draws.

name: Zinnia
description: Everything points at your king. I'll sort out the details later.

name: Corentin
description: Coffee, clock, calculation. In that order.

name: Mireille
description: I coach juniors on weekdays. Today I'm the one being tested.

name: Thaddeus
description: Prophylaxis is just good manners. I'll stop your plan before you've made it.

name: Kestrel
description: I hunt weak squares the way a hawk hunts a field.

name: Elowen
description: Every position tells a story. I like to read ahead.

name: Orrin
description: I'll trade into an endgame and grind for sixty moves if I have to.

name: Valka
description: Sharp lines only. If it's quiet, I'll make it loud.

name: Ottilie
description: Ten thousand puzzles solved. You're next.

name: Lysander
description: Patience wins more games than brilliance. I have plenty of both.

name: Seraphine
description: Quiet moves, deep plans. You'll feel the squeeze before you see it.

name: Halvard
description: I calculate in silence. Don't take it personally.

name: Vesper
description: Full engine skill, no mercy. Afterwards, ask the move why.

name: Brannoc
description: I carry the whole position on my shoulders. Try to make me drop it.

name: Solenne
description: The top of the ladder: full skill and my longest think. Bring your best idea.

name: Aurelio
description: Nobody beats me often. Everybody learns something trying.

name: Mirra
description: I play up when you're ahead and ease off when you're behind.

name: Tobiah
description: I'll match your level as we go. Let's keep it close.

name: Calla
description: Win material and I sharpen up. Lose some and I'll give you room to recover.

name: Emrys
description: The better you play, the harder I push back.

name: Sable
description: I'm strong, but I adjust so every game stays instructive.
